# Page 1^page=1
Free Claude Cowork Skills 380+ Free Skills You Can Add Right Now These are real GitHub libraries of free skills you can drop into Claude Cowork (Claude Code). Each one teaches Claude new commands, agents, and workflows. Copy the files, drop them in your project, and Claude learns instantly. THE BIG LIBRARIES Awesome Agent Skills 380+ agent skills contributed by official dev teams and the community. Includes official skills from Anthropic, Google, Vercel, Stripe, Cloudflare, and Netlify. Claude Command Suite 148 slash commands and 54 AI agents ready to install. Covers code review, feature creation, security audits, and architectural analysis. Production-Ready Commands 57 battle-tested commands across 5 categories: Claude Code Essentials, Full-Stack Development, Security Hardening, Data and ML Pipeline, Infrastructure and DevOps. CURATED LISTS Awesome Claude Code The most organized curated list of skills, hooks, slash commands, and agent orchestrators. Also available as a browsable web directory. Awesome Claude Skills 20+ battle-tested skills including /brainstorm, /write-plan, and /execute-plan. Clean, focused, and beginner-friendly. Claude Code Settings Settings, custom commands, skills, and sub-agents for enhanced development workflows. Good all-in-one starter kit. WEB DIRECTORY awesomeclaude.ai Browse the full Awesome Claude Code collection in a clean web interface. Best way to explore before downloading. HOW TO INSTALL 1. Download the .md skill files from any repo above. 2. Copy them to ~/.claude/commands/ (global) or your-project/.claude/commands/ (project-only). 3. Restart Claude Code. The skills are immediately available. Best value: Start with Awesome Agent Skills for the biggest selection, then grab the Claude Command Suite for ready-made dev workflows. TOTAL FREE VALUE 380+ skills, 148 slash commands, 54 AI agents. All free. All open source. PRO TIPS Review any skill file before installing. Skills run inside Claude Code with full project access, so always check what a skill does before adding it.

Skill files go in .claude/commands/ inside your project for project-specific skills, or ~/.claude/commands/ to make them available everywhere. Compiled by @builtbystephan. Last updated: March 2026.
